Detail: Every LQFP32 pad has a unique numbered manufacturer pin-map entry.
STM32 VDD/VDDA pin 4 and VSS/VSSA pin 5 are mapped to the power and return nets with both local decouplers.
SWD connector power, ground, SWDIO and SWCLK are assigned.
Four copper layers are defined in order.
L2 is a continuous GND reference; outer signal layers reference L2 and return paths must not cross splits.

Stack-up and pin-planning review only. The current PCB exporter handles single-layer F.Cu boards; this four-layer plan has not been routed, DRC-checked, fabricated, or validated for signal/power integrity.
